steps.what: Find the relevant approved family-support information for the client's needs
Read client context and check appropriate scope for the family discussion
Counsel family members about understanding, dealing with and supporting the client

tasks.design: Configure topic filters for the existing approved family-support library in {DOCS}. Remove repeated navigation only, retaining source selection, client-context reading in {OTHER}, disclosure judgement and family counseling.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the appropriate approved reference repeats library navigation before the conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native topic filters can expose maintained materials without generating family advice.
tasks.still_hard: Responding to family relationships while respecting the client's confidentiality and preferences.
tasks.human_edge: Support the family without displacing the client or overstating what can be shared.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less reference navigation with unchanged family-counseling responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: a maintained clinical-information library can use native topic filters; the counselor still decides relevance and provides family guidance.

assumptions: Provisional scenario already uses approved family-support references. OTHER is the clinical case application. A practice without that lookup has no new library duty and must be reweighted without this benefit.

Existing clinical content owners provide title, topic, version and review date. The counselor selects and reads actual material in s1-s2; missing or unfamiliar topics need retained manual search. A new library or new tagging workload is not assumed free.
Native filters are tested first. Only 2 of 10 repeated navigation points are removed; 8 remain for search, source reading and exceptions. Existing search runtime earns no credit.

The boundary is reference preparation and counseling. Actual progress notes belong to the separate paperwork task 18484 in this occupation, counted once there; no trailing family-activity log is added. Actual written disclosures require their own counted gated send.
unknowns: Existing approved library and repeated navigation effort
research_questions: Observe a family session and time actual reference navigation separately from reading and disclosure decisions.

incremental.description: Maintain topic shortcuts and check retired reference links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 2 navigation points less 0.5 upkeep. An uncommon co-occurring condition needs fresh references; reuse only 0.7 points of stable family-support navigation: 0.7 minus 0.5 = 0.2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan or conduct prevention and community mental-health programs

steps.what: Assess community needs and verify evidence for the proposed prevention program
Design the substance-abuse prevention or community-health program and write its plan
Develop the actual prevention exercises and educational content
Arrange supplied content into the existing program-material layout
Check program materials for accuracy, suitability and accessibility
Conduct the planned prevention or community-health program with participants

tasks.design: Test native material styles in {DOCS} for an existing prevention-program format. Reuse layout only, retaining community assessment, substantive program planning, original content, complete checks and delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual material arrangement accompanies substantive prevention planning.
tasks.enabler_now: Native styles can arrange supplied text and existing exercise fields.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting appropriate interventions for the community and evaluating evidence quality.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a credible program and adapt it to real participants.
tasks.altitude: Less material formatting with unchanged program design and delivery authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document templates can arrange supplied prevention materials, but community assessment and program design remain professional work.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a planning-heavy cycle that already produces program materials. Delivery-heavy or planning-only work needs reweighting. No new participant-progress log or management report is introduced.

The counselor develops checked content, exercises, references and accessibility requirements in s1-s3. Native layout is assessed first. Missing assets, bespoke materials and failed formatting remain s3/s5; excess repair reduces benefits.

Only 10 repeated material-arrangement points are removed. Existing rendering runtime, plan decisions and fresh content earn no saving. Ordinary author saves remain fully retained in the human steps and ungated.
This boundary contains no external publication or separate material-distribution send. Add any real send as its own counted gated action.
unknowns: Actual planning/delivery balance and reusable material format
research_questions: Reformat an actual prevention program and count bespoke content and correction effort.

incremental.description: Maintain material styles and accessibility examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 10 layout points less 1 upkeep. A new community program needs bespoke exercises and visual content; reuse only 2 points of ordinary heading and reference arrangement: 2 minus 1 = 1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Exchange treatment information with families and other interested parties

steps.what: Verify the treatment facts, participants and permitted information-sharing scope
Prepare the actual limited treatment-information brief used in the meeting

loop.purpose: Restate only counselor-selected permitted facts for the actual brief
loop.input: Verified facts and counselor-specified allowed scope
loop.output: Draft limited brief with fact references
loop.check: Counselor checks clinical meaning, omissions, attribution, recipients' scope and every potentially disclosive statement before using the brief
loop.stop: Unsupported risk, excess disclosure or two failed drafts returns preparation to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Native brief headings come first; variable fact restatement needs bounded drafting, while disclosure decisions stay human

steps.what: Meet families, probation officers, police or others and exchange only necessary treatment information

tasks.design: Use native brief sections in {DOCS} first for a meeting that already requires a limited information brief. A bounded draft restates only the counselor's selected permitted facts; scope decisions, complete meaning checks and the actual exchange remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: A limited brief requires factual restatement alongside consequential disclosure decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can assist restatement without selecting what may be shared.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing confidentiality with legitimate treatment information needs.
tasks.human_edge: Decide permitted disclosure and respond appropriately to questions in context.
tasks.altitude: Less brief restatement with unchanged disclosure responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: limited factual drafting can assist an existing treatment-meeting brief, but permitted disclosure and clinical meaning require professional judgement.

assumptions: Provisional scenario already prepares a limited brief actually used in the meeting. An oral-only exchange has no new brief duty and needs reweighting without this benefit. OTHER is the clinical case application.

The counselor verifies facts, dates, patient identity, actual participant identity and allowed scope in s1. Input selection and missing-fact work are retained. No free transcript, consent inference or new upstream summary is assumed.

Native brief sections come first. Only 2.25 of 15 restatement points are removed; 12.75 retain input, specialist writing, full check and draft repair. More repair lowers benefits. Ordinary author saves are fully retained and ungated.

The brief is not automatically sent. The actual conversation remains human. Any real email disclosure or formal report send requires a separately counted gate; routine progress records belong to the separate paperwork task, counted once.
unknowns: Existing brief duty and permitted information-sharing arrangements
research_questions: Compare a real treatment brief with allowed source facts and count meaning and disclosure corrections.

incremental.description: Maintain restricted-brief instructions and inspect omission patterns

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 2.25 restatement points less 0.6 upkeep. A contested or multi-party disclosure requires bespoke wording; reuse only 1 point of permitted factual restatement: 1 minus 0.6 = 0.4.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate or direct employee mental-health training

steps.what: Coordinate employee needs, trainer availability and actual mental-health workshop arrangements
Develop the actual mental-health course content and exercises
Apply the existing course layout and reference fields to supplied workshop content
Check full materials, final arrangements and the exact employee invitation recipients
Send the exact approved workshop invitation to the selected employees
Direct the employee mental-health workshop and respond to participants

tasks.design: Configure native course styles in {DOCS} for the counselor's actual employee workshop materials. Retain coordination in {CALENDAR} and {LMS}, fresh content, full checks and delivery, with the actual invitation send separately authorized after final arrangements exist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Course layout repeats alongside substantive training and coordination work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native styles can populate headings and reference fields from supplied content.
tasks.still_hard: Making training appropriate and responding constructively to sensitive employee questions.
tasks.human_edge: Provide credible mental-health education and know when to refer a concern privately.
tasks.altitude: Less small formatting work with unchanged training authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: course styles can reuse headings and references, while mental-health content and employee workshop delivery require a qualified trainer.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is an actual counselor-directed employee workshop with materials and invitations, not all organizational learning administration. No employee mental-health score or new completion log is added.

The counselor verifies audience, dates, room, source versions and content in s1-s2. Existing scheduling owners provide availability, but coordination and missing arrangements remain counted. No free new training capture is assumed.
Native styles are tested first. Only 5 repeated layout/reference points are removed. Full content checks, repair and ordinary author saves remain s4; excess repair lowers savings.
s4 binds the exact final invitation, arrangements and employee recipients before the separate actual send. s5 keeps its full small time. Ordinary author saves are ungated.
unknowns: Actual course template and coordination share
research_questions: Format one existing mental-health workshop and count repairs and actual invitation handling.

incremental.description: Maintain course styles and reference-field checks

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final workshop invitation, arrangements and employee recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 5 layout points less 0.5 upkeep. A new workshop needs bespoke exercises and visuals; reuse only 1 point of headings and references: 1 minus 0.5 = 0.5.
